# Vendor Dashboard Documentation

## 1. Module Overview

The Vendor Dashboard module provides an interface for vendors to view customer orders, check order summaries, filter orders by status, and view order details.

This module is currently a frontend demonstration using local sample data.

## 2. Documentation Index

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [01 - Dashboard & Orders](./01-dashboard-orders.md) | Dashboard summary, order filters, order cards, and order details |

## 3. Implemented Features

- New Orders Summary
- In Progress Orders Summary
- Order Status Filters:
  - All
  - New
  - In progress
  - Completed
- Order Cards
- Full-screen Order Details View
- Back Navigation

## 4. Planned Features

- Search orders by order ID or store name
- Completed Orders Summary
- Completed Sales Summary
- Update Order Status
- Backend API Integration
- Database Integration

## 5. Technology Used

- React Native
- Expo SDK 58
- Expo Router
- TypeScript
- JavaScript
- React Hooks
- React Native StyleSheet

## 6. Current Scope and Limitations

- The application uses local sample order data.
- No backend API is connected.
- No database is connected.
- Vendor login and authentication are not implemented.
- Order status updates are not implemented.
- Order data is not permanently stored.

## 7. Conclusion

The Vendor Dashboard provides a basic frontend interface for viewing and filtering customer orders. Additional order management features and backend integration are planned for future development.
